approvalSource: explicit super-administrator instruction to change and build CGMA so the EKODI platform route is https://ekodi.kr/cgma, the external public address is cgma.or.kr, and cgma.ekodi.kr is retired from user-facing use
summary: Separate the CGMA customer-owned public domain from EKODI internal routing: cgma.or.kr maps to the CGMA surface, ekodi.kr/cgma is the platform route, and cgma.ekodi.kr becomes a compatibility redirect.
migrationPlan: deploy and verify the ekodi.kr/cgma gateway first
change cgma.ekodi.kr from a user-facing site to a path-preserving redirect
allow both the platform route and customer-owned domain in authentication and CORS during transition
move cgma.or.kr DNS from the legacy provider to the EKODI edge only after DNS authority is available
switch remaining compatibility records to cgma.or.kr after HTTPS and callback verification
rollbackPlan: keep cgma.ekodi.kr attached as a compatibility alias until cgma.or.kr is healthy; rollback by reverting v1.5 through the guarded pipeline while preserving the working ekodi.kr/cgma gateway
rollbackProof: the first stage is non-destructive and leaves both the Pages upstream and the EKODI platform gateway intact; external DNS is not changed until a verified replacement route exists
